title: Refine Main Display idle hierarchy, neon preset borders, and card spacing
verify: Before any production write, capture fresh task-scoped RED from the current Main Display source and deterministic host visual/geometry probe. Record actual idle HH:mm bounds, central available region, three preset bounds and border/color observations, four card bounds/order and inter-card gaps. Do not reuse W24 or W25 evidence as current RED.

Implement only the bounded idle Main Display visual correction in DisplayCapability.kt with focused DisplayProjectionTest.kt support: make idle HH:mm substantially larger and adaptive to the available central space; keep countdown and overdue presentation outside this task and unchanged; render the three existing right-side preset controls as spacious transparent circles with one visually distinct neon gradient border per preset while preserving their order, labels, existing color identity, selected/active styling and touch routing; keep Yesterday equal to Tomorrow and Day-after, make all three smaller cards visibly about 20% smaller than Today, and enlarge the common weather-card gaps.

Obtain claim-equivalent GREEN through the same deterministic host measurement and same-size RED/GREEN contact sheet at the accepted 1280x720 model plus one bounded alternate host layout that exercises available-space adaptation. The evidence must show idle HH:mm remains inside the central/upper region above Today/Tomorrow/Day-after without clipping or overlap; the three preset bounds remain equal circles on the right with transparent interiors, per-slot neon gradient borders and unchanged color identity; the four slots remain ordered; Yesterday/Tomorrow/Day-after have equal measured allocation; Today is larger and the three smaller cards visibly express the operator's about-20%-smaller intent; and all card gaps share one larger value.

Apply a named Reviewer/visual-QA rubric to the same-size RED/GREEN contact sheet. Record PASS/FAIL with decisive measured bounds or visual observations for focal hierarchy, adaptive central occupation, transparent circular controls, per-preset gradient distinction, existing colors, preserved anchors, card relative sizing, larger uniform gaps, readability, no clipping/overlap and lightweight static treatment. Do not turn the operator's about-20% wording into a new fixed ratio, do not choose fixed dp values or gradient stops, and route to /feature-doctor FT-001 if such a product decision is required.

Run the clean build, complete host unit suite and static diff gate. Retain focused regression coverage for device-time clock/date, colon states, four ordered display-ready cards, existing palette/content/freshness ownership, preset labels/colors/selection/active state and Timer & Alert gesture/countdown/overdue/audio behavior. Regression coverage must show no TimerCapability, Platform Runtime, Weather Context, Forecast, Settings, resource, network or credential path was changed or re-owned.

Record Samsung GT-I9300I Android 11 custom-ROM 1280x720 readability, fullscreen, keep-screen-on and actual runtime rendering as DEFERRED when no authorized target observation exists. Host visual/static evidence must never be promoted to target-device runtime PASS. This planning/execution route does not launch an emulator/device, use adb, network or credentials.

Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-001 if adaptive sizing, about-20%-smaller card judgment, transparent neon gradient treatment or spacing cannot be resolved without a new fixed dp/ratio/gradient-stop product choice. Stop and route to /spec-design if execution needs a new owner, module, graph edge, public contract, dependency, resource pipeline or composition-root business logic. Stop before any write outside DisplayCapability.kt or DisplayProjectionTest.kt, any active countdown/overdue behavior change owned by later FT-006/FT-007 work, or any lifecycle, scheduler, checkpoint, terminal-state or historical-task change.
